status: Public source prerelease and website live; v0.1.16-alpha.1 release candidate verified

components.evidence_level: Public source prerelease; OLED kit verified over USB, Wi-Fi, an always-on relay, phone-only setup and two-account claim; native Grok Bot calls observed on the owner's setup
components.checks: The v0.1.16-alpha.1 candidate adds Phase 11: ADR 011 accepted, the two-account claim record (docs/verification/claim-2026-10-17.md), the guides Claim your gadget and Hand a gadget to someone, and the Today, next, later update. Component pins: gateway v0.1.0-alpha.15, ESP32 SDK v0.2.0-alpha.16, Linux SDK v0.1.0-alpha.7 and Home Assistant v0.1.0-alpha.5. On 17 October 2026 two people, each with Grok Bot on their own iPhone, passed every Phase 11 item on the owner's relay (gateway 0.1.0a15 candidates, then the release) and kit. Independent reproduction remains open.

components.evidence_level: Simulated; relay with accounts used by two people and one physical kit; native Grok Bot calls through serve --oauth observed on the owner's setup
components.checks: 376 tests (Python 3.11 to 3.14), Ruff, the first-success path, rehearse --accounts and the release workflow's fresh-download SHA256SUMS check passed; PyPI 0.1.0a15 matches SHA256SUMS. Adds accounts mode with claim codes, hashed device tokens, tools scoped by account with claim, remove, share and names, transfer with a 7-day grace period, and two sign-in fixes from the acceptance. On 17 October 2026 the owner's relay migrated to accounts mode with the owner's sign-in and kit unchanged, and two people passed the claim acceptance (hub docs/verification/claim-2026-10-17.md). The relay now runs 0.1.0a15 on port 8443.

55 tests passed, including the gateway integration tests against gateway dev with the claim fields; Ruff, package builds and the release workflow's SHA256SUMS check passed. Alpha.7 only re-pins protocol 0.1.0 with the optional claim fields; the agent does not send them. The gateway extra still pins gateway v0.1.0-alpha.10. No fresh Linux container, systemd or Raspberry Pi run in this release.

components.evidence_level: Host simulated; four firmware builds compiled; OLED kit physically accepted on one board over USB and Wi-Fi
components.checks: Host CTest suites (13/13, including claim), the contract check and four firmware builds passed. Alpha.16 adds opt-in claim codes: the OLED Wi-Fi build shows Code XXXX-XXXX while unclaimed (RAM 108,108 B, flash 933,393 B). On 17 October 2026 the owner's kit on this firmware was claimed by a second person's Grok Bot with its code and showed a transfer code after a BOOT reset and a phone re-join (hub docs/verification/claim-2026-10-17.md).

Unit tests, Ruff, package builds and twine check passed; the fixture probe reports zero tool calls and resource reads. Adds the release workflow; no probe behavior change. No real Home Assistant installation or Grok Bot connection was tested.
